qualification.education_qualification: B.E./B.Tech First Division, M.E./M.Tech First Division, GATE/UGC/CSIR-NET, Ph.D. or M.Tech with 3 years experience
qualification.details: Junior Research Fellow: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering/Aeronautical Engineering/Metallurgy/Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Engineering/Material Science/Engineering and Computational Mechanics/Production Engineering in First Division AND M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgy/Metallurgical Engineering/Material Engineering/Material Science/Manufacturing Engineering/Production Engineering/Machine/Design/Thermal Engineering/Fluids Engineering/Engineering Mechanics and Design/Applied Mechanics in First Division with valid GATE or UGC/CSIR-NET qualification. Desirable: experience in finite element analysis of composites. Project Associate-II: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical/Aerospace Engineering/Aeronautical Engineering/Metallurgy/Metallurgical Engineering/Materials Engineering/Material Science/Engineering and Computational Mechanics/Production Engineering in First Division AND M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical/Metallurgy/Metallurgical Engineering/Material Engineering/Material Science/Manufacturing Engineering/Production Engineering/Machine/Design/Thermal Engineering/Fluids Engineering/Engineering Mechanics and Design/Applied Mechanics in First Division with valid GATE or UGC/CSIR-NET qualification. Desirable: experience in finite element analysis of composites in ABAQUS/ANSYS. Research Associate-I: Doctoral (Ph.D.) Degree or M.Tech with minimum 3 years experience in research/teaching/design and development in Applied Mechanics/Engineering Mechanics and Design/Computational Mechanics/Design (Mechanical Engineering)/Stress Analysis/Solid Mechanics or relevant discipline with at least one SCI journal paper. Desirable: knowledge of mechanical and thermal characterization of composites and FEA in ANSYS/ABAQUS.

salary_details.details: Junior Research Fellow: Rs. 37,000/- per month + 20% HRA Project Associate-II: Rs. 35,000/- per month + 20% HRA (with qualification) or Rs. 28,000/- per month + 20% HRA (without qualification) Research Associate-I: Rs. 58,000/- per month + 20% HRA

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for MNNIT Allahabad Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://www.mnnit.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 is 16 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for JRF/PA-II/RA-I posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the JRF/PA-II/RA-I posts announced by MNNIT Allahabad in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: For the Junior Research Fellow position, a B.E./B.Tech in a relevant engineering discipline followed by an M.E./M.Tech with a valid GATE or UGC/CSIR-NET qualification is required.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for MNNIT Allahabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The Research Associate-I position offers a salary of Rs. 58,000/- per month plus 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates with an M.Tech degree and experience apply for the Research Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with an M.Tech degree and a minimum of 3 years of research/teaching/design and development experience in a relevant discipline are eligible for the Research Associate-I post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications, followed by an interview and document verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of MNNIT Allahabad, which is https://www.mnnit.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. Are there any age relaxations available?
faq.answer: Yes, the upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Female candidates as per DST norms.
